newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTARUUKKI BUILDS BALTIC SERVICE CENTRE.
newsitem.headline: RAUTARUUKKI BUILDS BALTIC SERVICE CENTRE.

text.p: Finnish steelmaker Rautaruukki Oy said on Monday its Keskometalli Oy unit would strengthen its service and sales network in the Baltic Sea region by building a new steel service centre in the Estonian town of Parnu.
"In adidtion to the sevice centre, the Rautaruukki subsidiary is creating its own service company network covering the entire Baltic region," Rautaruukki said in a statement.

The new service centre will be built in connection with Rautaruukki's Rannila Steel Oy's AS Rannila Profiili steel profile factory in Parnu and would be opened in late summer 1997, the company said, but gave no value for the project.
Rautaruukki said the new service centre and sales network would help it strengthen its position in the growing Baltic steel market.
"Sales by the Rautaruukki group in the Baltic countries and the Baltic Sea region have grown rapidly in the last few years," it said.
